title: oxypolis ternata
intro: Oxypolis ternata, commonly known as Kohia or Pittosporum ferrugineum, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Oxypolis ternata include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and potential antiviral and antibacterial properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues.
